recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant Event elements or restore older patient/dispenser/statusReason wording under FHIR-12386; any future mapping cleanup should use a current Pharmacy/Workflow tracker that evaluates the current Event pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-12386 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to harmonize MedicationDispense with the Workflow Event logical model. Its resolution says the spreadsheet evaluated all Event logical-model elements, many would be implemented, and not every Event element would be added to MedicationDispense.
initial_application: Git commit 0c976c878b6cfd93e5d5fd478b86506f28c517bc explicitly applied TR #12386. It updated MedicationDispense examples from patient/dispenser to subject/performer, changed the MedicationDispense compartment entry from patient to subject and performer, and added preparation to the status-code alignment.
additional_context: MedicationDispense and the Event logical model are both active in source/fhir.ini. Current MedicationDispense declares the Workflow Pattern mapping and maps the resource plus key elements to Event. Later Published Pharmacy issue FHIR-14021 re-aligned MedicationDispense to an updated Event pattern, and FHIR-34000 renamed MedicationDispense.statusReason to notPerformedReason, so the current source should not be forced back to the older spreadsheet shape.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build-scope conformance source already carries the substantive FHIR-12386 harmonization and remaining Event divergences are either within the original partial-scope resolution or are explained by later applied decisions.
